reference_scope: Independent AI visual annotation, disjoint rows per annotator; no duplicate-annotator disagreement estimate
reference_release: Predictions completed and hashed before GO messages to independent annotators

label_blinding.scope: Original PDF OCR fields were present in locator read by all three annotators; classifiers and glyph candidates withheld. See annotator notes.

metric_definitions.top_k: k image templates, each retaining chart numeric candidates
metric_definitions.whole_row: same drawn count and each ordered candidate set intersects; unresolved reference prevents a pass
metric_definitions.unique_sequence: all reference and top-one code sets singleton and equal; denominator unique-reference rows
metric_definitions.aligned_recall: maximum compatible matches among minimum candidate-edit alignments divided by resolved reference units
metric_definitions.same_position: compatible positions on equal-count rows only
metric_definitions.calibration: candidate-set correctness on resolved same-position units in equal-count rows
